Your holdings: Your leveraged SOXL is down a painful -46.4% and SPAL is down -60.64%. These are your most pressing concerns, especially with margin amplifying drops. SMH is also down -9.43%.

Watch: Keep an eye on any further news regarding AI talent shifts and broader geopolitical developments, as these can quickly swing market sentiment for your concentrated tech book.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions and stay vigilant on macro risks.
plays: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL. It's a leveraged ETF, down -46.4%, and its "SELL" status combined with the note about decay suggests it's a high-risk holding that's already significantly underperforming.
Review your SPAL position. This is another leveraged ETF, down -60.64%, and its "NEW" status doesn't negate the significant loss and inherent decay risk.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
